capabilities.body: OpenAmer a riring an makur, a makur ngune ian teminal, brauser, babijo me kod, me a kawor met e ar epon.
capabilities.title: Ajen ae a dorer me eiy imin am nukabwan

capabilities.body: Am dorer, anem me model e mi ian kompiuta aiy. Eko imin e aijeda ngaga wo eko ebōk.
capabilities.title: Am kompiuta, am data

capabilities.body: 186 dorer, ngune korin dorer ae wo ereda. Ijin moen app a ebōk am dorer.
capabilities.title: Am dorer, ngune an epon

capabilities.body: An makur a kawor ian makur am riring, me makur in ar an eawe ngaga wo aeoen ngune.
capabilities.title: Aren makur ae a tsimor

help: Ribim kompiuta aiy e kona ar internet.
Aeoen riring an oagada — eko riring edae imin ar oyon.
Ngaga eko epon erab, bedu babijon an makur; kor in imwin a engame met eko oyon.
failure.lead: Eko imin ar aduwawe ngune eko dorer — OpenAmer a eow ijin e ar eow, me ngaga wo aeoen riring, a ngago ijin.
failure.leadUpdate: OpenAmer e mi ngune berjon an mo me a makur. Eko imin ar aduwawe ian etang.
failure.title: An oagada eko oyon

language.lead: An oagada a ngago ngune dorer wo rine ijin. Wo kona aduwawe ian app imwin.
language.title: Rine am dorer

progress.lead: Oagada etai: OpenAmer a bwouda imin e eo me a oagada kompiuta aiy. An edae imwin eko aeoen riring.
progress.leadUpdate: OpenAmer a aduwawe berjon an mo. Am dorer, anem me oagada eko aduwawe.
progress.title: Oagada OpenAmer

cards.body: Bedu app me dorer imin wo eo ar riring. OpenAmer a makur ian imwin me a engame an makur.
cards.title: Oij ngune etai korin dorer

cards.body: Oagada → Engame → Dorer. 186 dorer, wo kona aduwawe ian ewak ijin.
cards.title: Rine am dorer

cards.body: Makur ae ar aeoen a riring an makur — edae imwin, etai dorer an makur a kona.
cards.title: Iturun eiy anem

success.errorTitle: Eko kona oij app in kompiuta
success.lead: Imin ikot ar oagada. OpenAmer am ngage — ian kompiuta aiy, ngune am dorer.
success.title: OpenAmer ar oyon

bullets: A makur ian am kompiuta — am dorer a mi ian kompiuta aiy
186 dorer, me korin dorer ae wo ereda
Wo kona aduwawe imin ikot imwin; eko imin a mi ngune an ngage atsin
welcome.lead: Am ajen. Ian am kompiuta. Ngune am dorer.
welcome.leadUpdate: OpenAmer an edae ar oyon. A aduwawe berjon an mo me a kawor am dorer me oagada ikot.
welcome.note: A eo minit ekau ngune internet ae epon.
welcome.title: Ekamawir omo ian OpenAmer
